commits.message:
feat: reject unsupported size with 400 instead of silent fallback

DateIconService.generate now raises ValueError listing SIZES_ALLOWED when
the requested size is not supported, instead of silently coercing it to
64. The route's existing ValueError handler maps it to HTTP 400.

Feature #4 strict_size_validation.

commits.message:
feat: add Cache-Control and ETag with 304 support to icon responses

Date icons are deterministic for a given query, so /icon responses now
send Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 and a strong ETag derived from
the effective date, theme, lang, size and (for the custom theme) colors.
A matching If-None-Match returns 304 with an empty body.

Feature #6 cache_headers.
